headline: Portfolio Outperformance vs. SPY YTD
summary: As of October 16, 2026, the portfolio set is outperforming the SPY benchmark with an average return of 23.89% compared to SPY's 12.63%. This results in a current average alpha of 11.26%, indicating that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but are also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has delivered a notable return of 38.03%, significantly contributing to the overall outperformance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', has returned only 1.88%, highlighting a disparity in performance within the group. This outperformance against SPY is particularly relevant during periods of market uncertainty, as it suggests resilience in the portfolio's strategy. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
